offering_description.value: Leases commercial aircraft and jet engines to airlines worldwide and overhauls engines and engine modules in-house. Earns lease income from its equipment portfolio and repair revenue from maintenance and parts work.

primary_products.value: commercial jet engines; commercial aircraft; engine modules and spare parts

primary_services.value: engine maintenance and overhaul; engine module repair; aftermarket parts services

customer_segment.value: B2B: airlines, aircraft lessors and aviation maintenance providers

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: aircraft and engine lease payments from airlines; service fees: maintenance, repair and overhaul work on engines and modules; product sales: sales of engine parts and serviceable equipment
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases aircraft and engines, sold to airlines as lease payments; service provider: overhauls engines and modules taken in from airlines and lessors

geography_served.value: global: airline customers across North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: aircraft and engine leasing, engine maintenance and overhaul, and aftermarket parts sharing airline customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct leasing and sales agreements with airlines and lessors; own locations: company-operated engine maintenance and repair facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aviation airworthiness and safety rules for maintenance and leased aircraft from FAA and EASA
